reading: Huw Edwards used to read the news for the BBC.
Some people are angry about new interviews with him.
In 2024, a court found him guilty of crimes involving sexual images of children.
He gave an interview for a Channel 4 documentary, a programme about real people or events.
There is also an interview for a podcast, an audio programme people can listen to online.
The prime minister's office said it did not want to hear Edwards's views.
It said television companies should think carefully about the people watching their programmes.
Channel 4 said Edwards answered questions about his crimes in the programme.
One government minister said Channel 4's plan made her feel sick.
The documentary and podcast are due to come out on Tuesday.

vocabulary.definition: Conversations where someone asks a person questions to learn about their life or ideas.
Feeling very unhappy about something and wanting to shout or complain.
Having done something against the law, as decided by a court.
With time and thought, so you can avoid mistakes.
Things you ask when you want to know something.

entries.ja: ある人の生活や考えを知るために、その人に質問をする会話。
entries.ko: 어떤 사람의 삶이나 생각을 알아보기 위해 그 사람에게 질문하는 대화.
entries.zh-Hans: 为了了解一个人的生活或想法而向这个人提问的交谈。
entries.es: Conversaciones en las que alguien hace preguntas a una persona para conocer su vida o sus ideas.
entries.pt-BR: Conversas em que alguém faz perguntas a uma pessoa para conhecer sua vida ou suas ideias.
entries.fr: Conversations dans lesquelles quelqu’un pose des questions à une personne pour connaître sa vie ou ses idées.
entries.de: Gespräche, in denen jemand einer Person Fragen stellt, um etwas über ihr Leben oder ihre Gedanken zu erfahren.

entries.ja: 何かに対してとても不満を感じ、大声を出したり文句を言ったりしたい気持ち。
entries.ko: 어떤 일에 매우 불만을 느껴 소리를 지르거나 불평하고 싶은 상태.
entries.zh-Hans: 对某件事感到很不满，想要大喊或抱怨。
entries.es: Sentir un gran descontento por algo y tener ganas de gritar o quejarse.
entries.pt-BR: Sentir muito descontentamento com alguma coisa e ter vontade de gritar ou reclamar.
entries.fr: Éprouver un grand mécontentement à propos de quelque chose et avoir envie de crier ou de se plaindre.
entries.de: Über etwas sehr unzufrieden sein und schreien oder sich beschweren wollen.

entries.ja: 法律に違反することをしたと裁判所に判断された状態。
entries.ko: 법을 어기는 일을 했다고 법원이 판단한 상태.
entries.zh-Hans: 经法院认定做了违法的事。
entries.es: Haber hecho algo contra la ley, según lo decidido por un tribunal.
entries.pt-BR: Ter feito algo contra a lei, conforme decidido por um tribunal.
entries.fr: Avoir fait quelque chose de contraire à la loi, selon la décision d’un tribunal.
entries.de: Laut dem Urteil eines Gerichts etwas getan haben, das gegen das Gesetz verstößt.

entries.ja: ある物事について、その人が考えていること。
entries.ko: 어떤 것에 대해 누군가가 생각하는 내용.
entries.zh-Hans: 一个人对某件事的想法。
entries.es: Lo que una persona piensa sobre algo.
entries.pt-BR: O que uma pessoa pensa sobre alguma coisa.
entries.fr: Ce qu’une personne pense de quelque chose.

entries.ja: 間違いを避けられるように、時間をかけてよく考えながら。
entries.ko: 실수를 피할 수 있도록 시간을 들여 잘 생각하며.
entries.zh-Hans: 花时间认真思考，以便避免出错。
entries.es: Tomándose tiempo y pensando bien para poder evitar errores.
entries.pt-BR: Dedicando tempo e pensando bem para poder evitar erros.
entries.fr: En prenant le temps de bien réfléchir pour pouvoir éviter les erreurs.
entries.de: Indem man sich Zeit nimmt und gut nachdenkt, um Fehler vermeiden zu können.

entries.ja: 何かを知りたいときに尋ねること。
entries.ko: 무언가를 알고 싶을 때 묻는 말.
entries.zh-Hans: 想知道某件事时提出的问题。
entries.es: Cosas que preguntas cuando quieres saber algo.
entries.pt-BR: Coisas que você pergunta quando quer saber algo.
entries.fr: Ce qu’on demande quand on veut savoir quelque chose.
entries.de: Das, was man fragt, wenn man etwas wissen möchte.
